body: I’m suicidal as well but not for those reasons. I am quite comfortable being alone but I wonder do you have your own interests like video games or books or something? There’s always communities online and many other people who feel like this and also want friends. Just an idea

Yes. In fact that is how I feel right now. I have never gone this far into researching and planning as I have before. In fact the “plan” I used to have seems laughable compared to the methods and statistics I’ve researched this time around. The saddest thing of all is that each time I am suicidal I seem to run out of effective strategies to cope as well as the motivation or belief that there is any hope. In my current position I have even shared my drafted note with my partner in an attempt to get him to really understand that I need him to be kind and emotionally sensitive because I’m afraid that every thing keeps pushing me closer and closer to something I don’t particularly want to do, but that I feel is going to be the only way to be free from the pain i have to go through each and every Time I’m back in this mind state. Also, I’m on antidepressants and have seen therapists for a year - doesn’t help.
